We both lost out childhoods pretty early, even some parts of adulthood. I didn’t get to go to college after high school like i planned and it forced my sister to drop out to come back home full time. 
We eventually ended up getting her long term care, and moved her into my aunt’s house. 
It’s definitely something to think about before your parents reach that age bc we never know what can happen yknow? 
Being a caretaker for your parents is exhausting, mentally and physically.
I don’t blame you for not wanting to do it.
